parameters.initialMessages:
Hi there! 👋
My name is Persona. I can help you with managing your news

parameters.message:
Available commands:
register - create an account
login - sign in
settings - view your settings
topics - update your interests
schedule - update delivery time
email - update your email
logout - sign out
subscribe - enable newsletters
unsubscribe - disable newsletters
delete account - delete your data
cancel - cancel the current action
Unknown command. Type "help" to see the available commands.
Current action cancelled.
Choose a username. Type "cancel" to stop registration.
This username is unavailable. Choose another username or type "cancel".
Choose a password with at least 12 characters. Use only a dummy password during development.
Password must contain at least 12 characters. Try again or type "cancel".
Enter your email address or type "cancel".
Invalid email format. Try again or type "cancel".
Enter your topics separated by commas, for example: technology, science, business. Type "cancel" to stop.
Enter at least one topic, for example: technology, science. Type "cancel" to stop.
Choose the newsletter delivery time in HH:mm format, for example 08:30. Type "cancel" to stop.
Invalid time. Use the HH:mm format, for example 08:30. Type "cancel" to stop.
Enter an IANA timezone, for example Europe/Paris, or type "default" to use Europe/Paris. Type "cancel" to stop.
Invalid timezone. Enter an IANA timezone such as Europe/Paris, or type "default".
The account was not created. Type "I CONSENT" to confirm, or type "cancel" to stop registration.
Account created successfully. You are now logged in. Type "settings" to view your newsletter preferences.
You are already logged in. Type "logout" before logging in with another account.
Enter your username. Type "cancel" to stop login.
Enter your password. Type "cancel" to stop login.
Invalid username or password. Try again or type "cancel".
This account is temporarily locked after too many failed attempts. Try again later or type "cancel".

Logged out successfully.
You are not logged in.
